verdict.rationale: RudderStack ships a dedicated Tracking Plans feature explicitly described as monitoring and acting on non-compliant event data at the source, catching issues in transit and fixing/filtering data before it impacts downstream teams, and MCP tooling lets engineers review tracking plans and their event schemas. This directly matches the schema-enforcement story rather than just observability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the enforcement mechanics (exact block vs quarantine vs flag behavior) and deeper technical docs beyond marketing-style summaries.
